jobs.title: Director of Operations, Slate Development
jobs.location: US - Culver City, California, United States; US - United States
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Director, Slate Operations to join our Slate Development Group team in the US remotely or in Culver City on a flexible hybrid model.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

Slate Operations keeps Scopely's game development slate moving. We oversee execution and cross-functional alignment across the games in development — connecting game teams and central teams so decisions get made once and stick, running the cadence that keeps everyone aligned, and clearing the path so teams can build.

What You'll Do:

We're looking for a Director, Slate Operations to own this end to end. There are two sides to it: keeping the Group running as an organization — its cadence, process, and the day-to-day support the Game Board, Head of Slate Development and leadership team rely on — and running program management for the Game Development Framework (GDF) so games move cleanly from concept to launch. You'll sit inside the Slate Development Group but work with every part of Scopely: game teams, divisional leadership, finance, strategy, and corporate development.

- Be the operational point of contact for specific in-development games — running the GDF cadence and connecting game and central teams so decisions get made once and aren't re-litigated. The main goal is to be the end to end steward for game teams in the game development framework.

- Deliver operational excellence within our internal team, shaping our service model, priorities, and ways of working. Evolve our capabilities as needs change.

- Drive the cross-slate operating model so independent game teams reuse what already works instead of rebuilding it.

- Bring structure to consequential decisions — organize the inputs, assumptions, and trade-offs early so the owners and the room can reach real alignment before committing.

- Own a capstone project — one meaty area you drive end to end, for example: evolving the GDF, owning launch readiness, or operationalizing central partnerships, depending on where the need is.

- Keep investment decisions well-informed — track progress across games at different stages, and surface Greenlight Case, budget, staffing, and dependency status so leadership can challenge and decide.

- Unblock teams through the development cycle, especially at launch readiness, by clearing operational issues with central partners (legal, IT, procurement, finance, logistics) so teams stay focused on the game. Partner with marketing, strategy, and divisional leadership so launches go out clean.

- Give teams operational support — production perspective, process, facilitation, and help navigating the GDF.

- Operationalize playtests and validation — help build and run research, playtest, and validation plans, and package the findings so vertical owners and leaders can form the recommendation.

- Utilize the latest AI technologies to keep information flowing — the dashboards, status, and key dates people need to see, without the overhead.

What We’re Looking For:

- Bachelor's degree, MBA a plus — or the equivalent in experience.

- 10+ years in program/project management across tech and direct-to-consumer businesses, at least 5 of them in games, working within or alongside a development team.

- You know how games get made and sold — development, publishing, platforms, business models. You don't need to have shipped one yourself, but you get what game teams are up against.

- You've supported senior execs in a fast-moving environment and you like the pace — taking initiative, juggling priorities, switching gears without losing the thread.

- You can run a lot of projects at once, ideally a mix of R&D and live.

- You're comfortable in ambiguity and good at creating clarity for other people. You make sound calls in the company's interest and know when to escalate.

- You can hold your own with P&Ls and free-to-play KPIs.

- You spot the process that's slowing people down and fix it — and you'll push back and start the right debate when it matters.

- You build trust with all kinds of people at every level and don't flinch at the hard conversations — with the presence to grow into a partner to senior game leaders over time.

- You write clearly and fast, and you can build a strong deck with cross-functional input.

- Detail and organization come naturally to you.

- Low ego, business outcomes first, open to feedback — and genuinely curious about every part of the business.

- You play games and care about the industry.

For candidates in CA, CO, NJ, NY, and WA, the annual salary range is provided below. In addition to base pay, employees may be eligible for equity, bonuses, and a comprehensive benefits package, including healthcare benefits, retirement benefits, pet insurance, paid holidays, paid Scopely free days, and unlimited paid time off. Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

CA, CO, NJ, NY, and WA Annual Salary Range
$139,400 — $205,000 USD

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/ .

Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official website and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @ scopely.com .

Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact recruiting@scopely.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice .

Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

jobs.title: General Manager - Monster Hunter Now
jobs.description:
Scopely Explore (formerly known as Niantic), the creator of hit games including Pokémon GO, Pikmin Bloom, Monster Hunter Now, and  is seeking a General Manager to lead the Monster Hunter Now franchise.  You will lead a talented, fast paced, multi-disciplinary team of game makers based in Tokyo, with supporting team members in San Francisco, Culver City and Seattle. You will be responsible for driving the end to end game vision, franchise strategy, and ultimately business results.  Your role will be central in living up to the ambitious vision for Monster Hunter Now, inspiring millions of players to get out, go hunt, and grow stronger together.

What you will do

- Manage the game leadership team, developing leaders across disciplines including Design, Product, Production, and Engineering

- Build a franchise strategy that delivers strong business results across a multi-year time horizon

- Drive rigor across the product development process, actively engaging in the roadmap, production pipeline, and live ops calendar development

- Proactively drive the adoption of AI to accelerate productivity, leading from the front by building and utilizing on a daily basis

- Participate in Product Reviews, providing feedback and coaching to ensure excellent, mission aligned product design for all features

- Take accountability for driving KPI impact via a well executed Product, Live Ops and Data strategy

- Drive market analysis, user research, and knowledge sharing across the team to drive more effective decision making

- Build a strong, collaborative relationship with IP holders, ensuring brand integrity and generating concepts (both in game and marketing) that resonate with fans

- Develop a deeply integrated audience strategy working across both Product and Marketing to drive player growth

- Represent the Monster Hunter Now team and franchise in executive forums with leadership from across Scopely Explore and Scopely

- Craft and execute a thoughtful AI strategy to augment the performance of both the team and the game using forward looking technology

- Collaborate with cross-functional team members and stakeholders, including regular and reliable attendance and leadership of key meetings

- Act as a driver of culture on the team, fostering learning, collaboration, player centricity, and excellence with an outcome oriented mindset

- Required in-office 3 days per week on Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday

What you will need

- 10+ years leadership experience in free to play gaming, with hands on experience in Product, Design and/or Production

- Track record of operating and scaling successful free to play mobile games post-launch

- Experience managing roadmaps and shipping KPI impacting features

- Deep understanding of content development and live operations in midcore games

- Management experience across creative and analytical disciplines including Product, Design, Live Operations and Production

- Expertise with analyzing and interpreting data to make data informed decisions

- Excellent verbal and written communication in both English and Japanese

- Comfort partnering with and influencing executive stakeholders across time zones and geographies

- Ability to manage, coach, and lead by example to develop team members

- Flexibility in a demanding team environment

- Passion for video games; an avid gamer with a proven understanding of mobile games

- Have worked in a leadership role on a high profile game with a significant amount of daily active users

- Ability to work in a fast-paced hybrid environment and handle stress appropriately and ability to solve practical problems and be sufficiently adaptable to handle dynamic situations with little advance notice

- Experience working on cross-functional teams with ability to communicate effectively through written and verbal communications, including asynchronous interactions with others

- Belief in the value of bringing people together through games to explore in the real world

- Based in, or able to relocate and work in Japan

Plus If...!

-
Deep understanding and/or fandom of the Monster Hunter franchise

-
Familiarity as a player with Monster Hunter Now, Pikmin Bloom, and/or Pokemon Go

-
Experience, interest, and excitement around AR/location based games or features

jobs.title: Live Ops Manager - MARVEL Strike Force
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for a Live Ops Manager to join our MARVEL Strike Force team in Canada on a remote basis or Mexico City on a hybrid basis.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

MARVEL Strike Force is Scopely's squad-based Hero Collector RPG, housing heroes and villains across the Marvel Universe.

What You Will Do

You will be the operational bridge between Live Ops strategy and high-quality in-game execution. You will gather requirements from the events and monetization teams, translate them into executable plans and configurable designs, and manage work across our Live Ops implementation partner. The role is accountable not only for accurate configuration, but also for ensuring that offers, events, milestones, and rewards remain complementary to the broader strategy and value proposition.

- Translate Strategy into Execution: Turn high-level designs for offers, events, milestones, rewards, and other Live Ops components into clear Jira tickets, configuration specifications, acceptance criteria, and implementation plans

- Manage the Implementation Partner: Prioritize, delegate, and track work across our Live Ops implementation partner, ensuring that owners, dependencies, timing, and escalation paths are clear

- Own Execution Readiness: Maintain a reliable view of upcoming launches, confirm that requirements and assets are complete, and drive issues to resolution before they create player-facing or business risk

- Provide Strategic and Value Quality Assurance: Review configured content for technical accuracy, player value, internal consistency, and alignment with the intended engagement and monetization strategy

- Coordinate Across Live Ops: Gather direction from events and monetization product managers, resolve conflicts across overlapping workstreams, and ensure that individual components reinforce the overall monthly plan

- Improve Operating Systems: Create and refine templates, checklists, documentation, and repeatable workflows that increase implementation speed, reduce errors, and make execution easier to scale

- Use Data to Inform Delivery: Use performance data and player segmentation to understand the intent behind requirements, validate implementation choices, and support post-launch reviews

- Accelerate Through Artificial Intelligence: Use artificial intelligence tools, including Codex and ChatGPT, to develop requirements, analyze data, create documentation, identify inconsistencies, and improve execution quality

What We're Looking For

- 3+ years experience in live operations, product operations, production, product management, or a comparable execution-focused role in mobile or free-to-play games

- A high-ownership, hardworking operating style and a strong desire to grow a career in mobile game product management

- Exceptional organization, follow-through, and attention to detail across multiple concurrent deadlines and workstreams

- Experience translating ambiguous or high-level direction into precise tickets, requirements, and acceptance criteria; familiarity with Jira is strongly preferred

- The judgment to evaluate both configuration accuracy and whether an implementation supports the intended player and business outcomes

- Comfort managing external partners or distributed implementation teams through clear delegation, prioritization, feedback, and escalation

- Strong analytical skills and comfort using data to inform events and monetization requirements; Structured Query Language (SQL) proficiency is preferred

- Demonstrated comfort using artificial intelligence tools to accelerate analysis, documentation, quality assurance, and workflow improvement

- Clear written and verbal communication with product, economy, analytics, production, and implementation partners

Bonus Points

- Hands-on experience with SQL, BigQuery, Looker, or comparable analytics tools

- Experience designing milestone systems, event rewards, or progression-based monetization in a role-playing game or Hero Collector

- A deep understanding of the Marvel intellectual property and its player community

Please ensure that the résumé/CV you attach is written in English.

In addition to base pay, employees may be eligible for equity, bonuses, and a comprehensive benefits package, including healthcare benefits, retirement benefits, pet insurance, paid holidays, paid Scopely free days, and unlimited paid time off. Base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

$75,000 — $109,800 CAD
